field.label: Default provider
field.help: Which engine the dashboard widget and the scheduled runs use. Cloudflare needs no extra package and reports the Cloudflare PoP it measured against; Ookla uses speedtest-cli; iperf3 measures raw TCP throughput against a public iperf3 server.

field.label: Ookla server
field.help: Numeric speedtest.net server ID to measure against. Leave empty to let speedtest-cli pick the nearest server on every run. This WAN IP geolocates wrongly, so the automatic pick wanders between far-away servers: pin one to make the series comparable.

field.label: iperf3 server
field.help: Hostname or IP of the iperf3 server. Default: fra.speedtest.clouvider.net (Frankfurt). When it is busy the plugin falls back to a short built-in list.

field.label: iperf3 port
field.help: TCP port of the iperf3 server, 5200 by default. Public servers usually offer a range (5200-5209), one test at a time per port.

field.label: iperf3 streams
field.help: Parallel TCP streams, 1 to 16. Four is enough to fill a gigabit uplink from this box.
